The IMF Programs Dataset records participation in IMF lending programs in {{< dataset-value period >}}. The raw dataset lists {{< dataset-value counts.arrangements >}} arrangements and outright purchases for {{< dataset-value counts.members >}} IMF members, with their facilities, dates, and amounts. Most come from the IMF's History of Lending Commitments page; the other {{< dataset-value counts.added >}} come from IMF press releases, Executive Board documents, and other IMF publications. The panel dataset turns {{< dataset-value counts.panel_arrangements >}} of these arrangements into yearly indicators for {{< dataset-value counts.states >}} independent states: months under a program, and whether one was in force, for all, concessional, and non-concessional programs. The codebook explains how the data were collected and built.
